entries.what: Moves FE and items between Links on the same named network.
use: Right-click it, press **New** and name a network, or click one in the list to join.
Set **Energy** and **Items** to Send on one Link and Receive on another.
Feed a sender by cable, pipe or hopper. A receiver pushes out of its faces; a [[tesla_emitter_1]] on it sends its FE on.
Right-click a placed Link with the next Mk to upgrade it in place.
